card.name: Punctuation in transplant complication warnings
card.fires_on: Punctuation or a space right after a bracketed cross-reference or abbreviation, in warnings about transplant complications after PD-1/PD-L1 antibodies. It marks the break before the next list item or section number.

modes.label: Space before section number
modes.description: The space after the sentence end, just before a section reference like 5.3 in a highlights list.

modes.label: Closing mark after GVHD
modes.description: A comma or parenthesis right after GVHD or a grade, before the next complication in the list.
modes.example: hyperacute graft-versus-host-disease (GVHD<<),>> acute GVHD, chronic GVHD,

card.plain: It fires on the small punctuation spots in transplant-complication warnings where one list item ends and the next begins.
